name: Orange Coast District Elks
notes: 7711 Talbert Ave is Huntington Beach Elks Lodge #1959, a social club. Listed as a CAPOC/OC Food Bank distribution partner but no specific recurring public food-distribution day/time could be sourced. CAPOC page says sites operate independently with varying hours; call 211.

name: Robyne's Nest
notes: Robyne's Nest is an at-risk youth support org (school-based pantries + office). Office/donation hours Mon-Fri 9am-2pm, but no scheduled public food-distribution day/time; food is provided case-by-case, not a recurring pantry.

name: California Culinary Coalition
notes: Listed as CAPOC distribution partner. No specific recurring day/time found on their site or Facebook. A related Irvine food-distribution post exists but could not confirm day/time tied to this org/address.

name: Calvary Fellowship Northwood
notes: Listed as CAPOC distribution partner (52 Knollglen, Irvine). No credible specific recurring day/time could be found; searches returned unrelated Calvary churches.

name: Families Forward
scheduleText: Monday 9 AM-2 PM, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday 10 AM-3 PM
notes: Community Market (food pantry) at 8 Thomas, Irvine. BY APPOINTMENT ONLY - no walk-ins; call (949) 552-2727. Households can return no sooner than 14 days after last visit. Days/hours are specific and recurring, hence found, but appointment required.

name: Rise Church of La Habra
notes: 222 N Euclid St. Listed as CAPOC distribution partner but no specific recurring public day/time verifiable. (Committed Relief pantry with M/W/F 9-6 hours is a DIFFERENT org at 1370 S Euclid, not this church.) La Habra city food-assistance page does not list Rise Church.

name: Helping Hand Worldwide
notes: 31121 Holly Drive, Laguna Beach is the org's office/HQ (Mon-Fri 8am-5pm), not a public pantry. HHWW runs mobile food-pantry sites across OC on varying/by-appointment schedules (call 949-230-7318). One specific site (senior drive-thru, every other Thursday 9:45am) is at a Boys & Girls Club in IRVINE, not this Laguna Beach address, so not applied here.

name: Iglesia Vida Abundante
notes: 25241 Ericson Way, Laguna Hills. Listed as CAPOC distribution partner but no specific recurring day/time found on web, Facebook, or findhelp.

name: Lake Forest Apostalic Church
notes: 22600 Lambert St #1006, Lake Forest. Listed as CAPOC distribution partner but no specific recurring public day/time verifiable; searches returned unrelated Lake Forest orgs.

name: Transitions in Motherhood
notes: Free distribution (diapers, wipes, clothing, food) 3rd Saturday of each month, 11am-1pm, at 4111 Katella Ave, Los Alamitos. All welcome. Confirmed via City of Los Alamitos community calendar.
